title: TanStack AI on AI Gateway
description: Streaming chat with tool calling, structured extraction, and summaries with TanStack AI on Neon AI Gateway.

environment.name: TANSTACK_AI_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Stream a chat
operations.description: POST the AG-UI body that useChat sends to stream a reply over SSE, with a sample server tool.

operations.title: Extract structured data
operations.description: POST text to get a typed JSON object validated against a Zod schema.

operations.title: Summarize text
operations.description: POST text and an optional style and maxLength to get a summary.
